about_blocks.html: About Alberta Health Services – Youth Counseling Vegreville

about_blocks.text: If you’re a teenager, then you know that life can be pretty hectic. Between school, extracurricular activities, and socializing, there’s always something to do. And sometimes it’s hard to find the time or energy to focus on anything else. That’s where ALBERTA HEALTH SERVICES – YOUTH COUNSELING VEGREVILLE comes in handy.

about_blocks.text: This confidential service helps teenagers develop a lifestyle free from alcohol, tobacco, other drugs, and gambling abuse issues. Our team of professionals provides guidance and support 24/7/365 through online resources (such as videos), group sessions facilitated by a professional facilitator (both in-person and online), and phone counseling. We also offer customized interventions for specific situations or problems that your teenager may be facing.

about_blocks.text: We believe that every young person has the potential to become successful: If we can help remove some of the roadblocks standing in their way – whether they’re related to addiction or not – then we’ll have done our job well! So if you’re looking for an effective way to help your teen live healthier lives overall, contact us today!
